headerDisplay: Rooms and routines are read from the IR Remote Hub; set them up in its web UI. Install homebridge-alexa and/or homebridge-gsh to use them from Alexa or Google Home.

url.title: Hub URL
url.description: Address of the IR Remote Hub web app.

routines.title: Show routines as switches
routines.description: Each routine becomes a switch that runs it and turns itself back off.

pollInterval.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to pick up room/routine changes and the lights' current state.
